items.nl: Mobiele vuurgroep van Oekraïense luchtdoelbrigade schiet straalaangedreven Geran-4 neer met ZU-23-2-kanon
items.sEn: A mobile fire group of Ukraine's Lviv Anti-Aircraft Missile Brigade, named after Ivan Vyhovsky, says it shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran-4 one-way attack drone that was heading for the site the group was protecting.
